entities.name: Dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure
entities.description: Establishes an EPS bearer context with specific QoS and TFT between the UE and the EPC. Initiated by the network in WB-S1 mode, but may be requested by UE procedures.

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure
entities.description: Procedure through which UE can request dedicated bearer activation.

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure through which UE can request dedicated bearer activation.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which dedicated bearer activation can occur.

entities.name: Default EPS bearer context activation procedure
entities.description: Procedure that can be initiated together with dedicated bearer activation.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure whose completion can trigger dedicated bearer activation.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE
entities.description: ESM state for active EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE
entities.description: ESM state for inactive EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: EPS bearer context status IE
entities.description: Information element included in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to indicate bearer context status.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message
entities.description: Message that includes EPS bearer context status IE during inter-system mobility.

entities.name: Inter-system mobility from WB-S1 to NB-S1 in EMM-IDLE
entities.description: Condition triggering local deactivation of dedicated EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: Local deactivation of dedicated EPS bearer contexts
entities.description: UE behavior to deactivate dedicated bearer contexts during inter-system mobility.

relations.description: Dedicated bearer activation may be requested by UE bearer resource allocation procedure.
Dedicated bearer activation may be requested by UE bearer resource modification procedure.
Dedicated bearer activation can be part of attach procedure.
Dedicated bearer activation can be initiated together with default bearer activation.
Dedicated bearer activation can be initiated with service request procedure completion.
Inter-system mobility condition triggers local deactivation of dedicated bearers.
Inter-system mobility condition applies when UE has bearers in ACTIVE state.
Inter-system mobility condition applies in EMM-IDLE mode.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message includes EPS bearer context status IE.
Local deactivation sets bearer contexts to INACTIVE state.
